name: Golpo
long_description:
Golpo AI is the world's best platform to create fully produced whiteboard explainer videos from just a prompt or document. Instead of hiring an agency, you simply input a prompt or document explaining what you want, and in minutes you get a whiteboard explainer video in a style similar to Khan Academy or RSA Animate. After creation, you have the ability to edit all aspects of the video with just prompts. 

It's perfect for training, faceless YouTube, marketing, technical, and educational videos — any video where understanding is important. Trusted by over 170,000 users as of July '26, Golpo features include but are not limited to: 

1) Convert your narration into an explainer video (with your narration as audio and the video time aligned) 
2) Input your document or prompt. Document can be of virtually any format or type (text, audio, video etc.) 
3) Script-to-video with matching audio
4) Videos up to 10 minutes
5) 50+ languages
6) dead-simple editing after generation
7) Insert your own videos and images into the generation, used as-is without alteration.
8) 10+ visuals styles, including pen in hand, voice cloning, vertical video, custom branding and more! API access available.
one_liner: Create Whiteboard Explainer Videos with AI from a Prompt or Document

launches.title: Golpo  — Create animated explainer video in minutes with AI
launches.tagline: AI animated explainer video generator for education, enterprise training, and marketing
launches.body:
Hi YC! We're Shraman and Shreyas, brothers, Stanford CS students, and founders of **Golpo AI (YC S25)**.

We're building an AI explainer video generator that makes it possible for anyone to create animated educational videos, whiteboard animations, and professional explainer videos from a simple prompt or document.

Think of the visual explanations you'd find on **Khan Academy, 3Blue1Brown, AsapSCIENCE, or After Skool**, where complex topics become understandable through drawings, animation, and narration.

We're making that kind of video creation accessible to everyone.

**Try Golpo AI:** <https://video.golpoai.com>

### The problem: Great explanations are hard to produce

Words alone often aren't enough to explain complicated ideas.

A diagram can show what something looks like, but animation can reveal how it works, why it happens, and how different concepts connect.

That's why animated explainer videos are so effective for teaching mathematics, science, engineering, business processes, and complicated products.

But creating a great explainer video traditionally requires scripting, illustration, animation, narration, and editing, often taking days or weeks.

We wanted to make the entire process as simple as describing what you want to explain.

### What Golpo AI does

Golpo turns text prompts, PDFs, presentations, scripts, and documents into fully narrated, animated explainer videos in minutes.

Unlike generic AI video generators focused on cinematic footage, Golpo specializes in **visual explanations that teach concepts step by step**.

You can create:

* **Khan Academy-style whiteboard videos** that draw mathematical and scientific concepts as they're explained.
* **3Blue1Brown-inspired mathematical visualizations** that help make abstract concepts intuitive.
* **AsapSCIENCE-style science explainers** with hand-drawn illustrations and engaging narration.
* **After Skool-style animated educational storytelling** that brings ideas, history, and complex subjects to life.
* **Professional business explainer videos** for employee training, onboarding, sales enablement, and product marketing.

These are references to the kinds of educational experiences we help creators produce, not affiliations with those channels.

Golpo handles scripting, illustrations, animation, narration, and visual synchronization. You can then refine your video through natural-language instructions, without needing animation or video editing experience.

### Who we're building for

**1. Schools, universities, and educational institutions**

Teachers, professors, and course creators can turn lecture notes, textbooks, research papers, and presentations into engaging animated lessons.

Instead of asking students to memorize equations or read dense explanations, educators can show concepts unfolding visually.

**2. Enterprise learning and development (L&D)**

Large companies have enormous amounts of knowledge locked inside training manuals, standard operating procedures (SOPs), onboarding documents, technical documentation, and internal knowledge bases.

Golpo helps turn that information into animated employee training videos, compliance explainers, product training, and reusable learning modules.

Imagine transforming hundreds of pages of internal documentation into a searchable library of short training videos.

**3. Marketing and sales teams**

Marketing teams can create animated product explainer videos, SaaS demos, product launch videos, customer education content, and social media videos.

Instead of merely describing a complicated product, they can show exactly how it works.

**4. YouTubers and content creators**

Educational creators can produce whiteboard animations, faceless YouTube videos, animated science lessons, finance explainers, and long-form educational content without building a traditional animation team.

**5. Enterprise teams and developers**

We're also making Golpo accessible through the tools teams already use.

With Golpo's API, MCP server, and integrations, teams can bring AI video generation into their existing workflows, including:

* **Slack:** Connect team conversations and knowledge-sharing workflows with video creation.
* **Claude Code:** Generate narrated explainer videos directly from prompts, documents, and scripts in your development environment.
* **OpenAI Codex:** Create animated explainer videos through natural-language instructions without switching to a separate video editor.
* **MCP and API:** Build custom video-generation workflows and integrate Golpo into enterprise applications.

Our goal is to make creating an explainer video a natural part of how teams communicate knowledge, rather than a separate production project.

### Why not just use Veo, Remotion, or Claude Code?

There are already incredible tools for creating videos. But most weren't designed specifically to explain complex ideas visually.

**Google Veo 3** can generate beautiful cinematic footage, realistic motion, and audio. But generating an impressive clip is different from building a complete educational explanation where every visual needs to teach something, follow a logical sequence, and stay synchronized with the narration.

**Remotion** is a powerful framework for creating videos with React. It gives developers precise control over animations, but it's a coding framework, not an explainer video generator. When used for automatically generated explainers, the results can be limited by the available components and templates. Without substantial custom animation work, videos can end up looking like slides with transitions rather than concepts being drawn and explained.

**Claude Code and other coding agents** can generate animations using Remotion, Manim, or Python. But producing an engaging explainer video is harder than generating working animation code. AI-generated videos can rely heavily on text, boxes, basic diagrams, and simple transitions. The visual design can feel repetitive, and the result often resembles an animated presentation rather than a thoughtfully illustrated explanation. More sophisticated animations are possible, but usually require additional prompting, custom code, and iteration.

**Golpo takes a different approach.**

Rather than assembling a sequence of slides or generating isolated video clips, Golpo is built specifically for visual explanation.

It draws and animates concepts as they're narrated, introducing information step by step so viewers can follow how an idea develops.

Golpo handles the explanation, illustrations, animation, narration, and synchronization together, without requiring users to write animation code or manually construct scenes.

The goal isn't simply to generate a video. It's to create something that actually helps people understand.

### Our vision

We believe the next generation of educational content won't be limited to static documents, slides, or recorded lectures.

It will be visual, personalized, and increasingly generated on demand.

Imagine every complicated lesson, internal company process, research paper, or product explanation becoming an animated video that anyone can follow.

That's what we're building toward.

**Golpo AI is making animated explainer video creation accessible to anyone with an idea worth explaining.**

We'd love feedback from YC founders, educators, enterprise L&D teams, marketers, and developers.

Try creating your first explainer video for free:

<https://video.golpoai.com>

Thanks, YC!

Shraman & Shreyas\
Co-founders, Golpo AI (YC S25)
